title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(橋本和典研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Hashimoto Kazunori)
keywords: Aeronautics and astronautics engineering 2.Flight dynamics 3.Flight control 4.Autonomous vehicle
educationalGoal: Students will:(1) acquire the ability to find and solve problems, and to research, develop, design, and manufacture socially useful and high-quality products, on the basis of the basic knowledge learned in the Department of Aeronautics. (2) learn what technologies or new mechanisms are needed to achieve that purpose.
advice: This course is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics. To realize the educational objectives in the Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics, this course focuses on the following: Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models. Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to consider solutions based on the obtained results. In practice: Students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in the Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of the individual laboratory. (Should be revised as necessary) Students are expected to promote the problem finding/solving processes according to their project theme.
requiredKnowledge: It is desirable to obtain knowledge and take courses associated with your projects. Review mass motion, rigid motion, and aircraft characteristics.

activityGoals.body: Be able to define project themes and act on engineering design processes.
Be able to summarize in reports, and present and discuss the reports.
Be able to design, draft, manufacture (production), simulate, etc.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the purpose of the project theme and the promotion process accurately, and achieve the determined annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported on a Design Project activity support system. (2) Compile the intermediate results on the project into an interim report, and present and discuss the report. Complete the final report, and present and discuss the report at the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board. The final results can be published with academic societies in each specialized field. (3) Design and manufacture experimental devices on your own as necessary, and also evaluate the performance of the products.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the purpose of the project theme and the promotion process, and achieve the determined annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported on a Design Project activity support system. (2) Compile intermediate results on project into the interim report, and present the report. Complete the final report and present it at the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board. (3) Design and manufacture experimental devices on your own as necessary.
